title: Introduce invocation pivot metrics and alert-context sanitizer
author: Aisha Patel
ci_status: unit-tests: pass (flaky test fixed in second run)
description: Motivation: We see recurring noisy alerts where high-cardinality invocation tags and microtrace fragmentation make SLO triage slow. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) an invocation pivot metrics layer that emits compact, deterministic 'pivot' keys for each invocation (fingerprint of initial tokens + model_variant + route) and lightweight rollups (count, median latency, token-cost sum) and (2) an alert-context sanitizer that prunes and canonicalizes high-cardinality labels before they flow to alert rules and dashboards. Additionally, a trace-combiner merges short microtraces produced by prefetch/pipelined execution into a single synthetic root so traces are easier to inspect. Changes include new metric exporter, tracing combiner service, dashboard panels, and updated alert rules with hysteresis and quiet windows. See Linear tickets ENG-4583 and OBS-122 for design notes. Checklist: - [x] Add pivot key generator and exporter - [x] Implement trace-combiner and unit tests - [x] Add dashboard panels and example queries - [x] Update alert rules to use sanitized context and pivot rollups - [x] Run CI and fix lint/flake - [x] Add runbook entry and migration notes Backwards compatibility: pivot keys are emitted under a new metric namespace so existing consumers are unaffected; alert rules are updated to use sanitized labels but the original high-cardinality labels are still retained in raw traces for debug. Operational notes: the exporter is rate-limited by default; the sanitizer is configurable per-team via Observability Console. Rollout plan: feature flagged on internal staging for 2 weeks, then gradual 25/50/100% rollout on prod with canary telemetry. Links: design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4583/pivot-metrics-design, runbook stub: docs/internal/runbooks/pivot-metrics.md

ci_notes: Initial CI run failed due to a flaky test in tests/observability/test_combiner_flaky.py; root cause was a 10ms sleep assumption. Replaced with deterministic mock and reran. All checks now pass.
release_notes: Introduce 'pivot_metrics' namespace with per-invocation pivot keys and rollups; add alert-context sanitizer to reduce high-cardinality alert noise; trace-combiner merges paged/prefetch microtraces for easier debugging. See runbook for rollout and rollback steps.
migration_instructions: Consumers of raw high-cardinality labels are unaffected; to adopt pivot rollups, query metrics.pivot_metrics.<metric> by pivot_key and update alert rules to use sanitized.label.pivot_key. Example queries are in webapp/dashboards/pivot_metrics.json
notes_for_release_manager: Feature gated. Coordinate with SRE to enable on canary clusters and monitor pivot_metrics.count and alert_suppression.rate. Revert by disabling feature flag 'pivot_metrics' and removing pivot-based rules if needed.
